notes: A lilting 6/8 tide that starts below the home note, on the sixth, climbs by step to the third and holds it a whole bar, then slips down past the start to the fifth below. A little wistful; it begins on the minor chord. Autumn: E Dorian, lower and rounder; the answer puts the theme in the bass on the cello under a high held line.
